stem:
Charu lists these living things: neem, sparrow, buffalo, tulsi, and frog.

Which grouping uses a valid observable basis?

options.text: Neem and tulsi together as plants; sparrow, buffalo, and frog together as animals.
Neem with buffalo because both bring good luck.
Sparrow with frog only because animals can be grouped only by where they live.
Buffalo with frog because both names start with the same letter sound.

teacher.key_rationale: A valid grouping uses an observable common feature. Plants versus animals is such a basis. Luck, claiming only habitat works, or first-letter sound are not valid observable bases here.
